channel.title: Humanoids Daily
channel.description: We bring you the latest developments in robotics, with a special focus on humanoid robots and intelligent machines. From groundbreaking research to real-world applications, we cover the people, technologies, and innovations shaping the future of robotics.

item.title: Hack One Robot, Reach the Next: How Unitree’s G1 Left the Door Open to Root Takeover
item.description: A new security disclosure reveals how proximity and a cloud flaw enabled unauthenticated root takeover of Unitree’s G1 humanoid, spotlighting the physical risks of software security in embodied robotics.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: From AlphaGo to AstraTennis: Galbot Humanoids Complete 100+ Consecutive Rallies in Live Tennis Match
item.description: During the opening ceremony of the second World Humanoid Robot Games, Galbot showcased autonomous humanoids completing over 100 consecutive tennis rallies against and alongside human athletes.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Lightberry Unveils Lumi: A $40k Interactive Humanoid Built on a Unitree Core
item.description: San Francisco startup Lightberry has opened reservations for Lumi, a $39,990 bipedal robot pairing a Unitree mechanical baseline with custom American sensing, NVIDIA Thor compute, and a modular interaction engine.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: South Korea Commits KRW 2.3 Trillion to Build Full-Stack Humanoid Robotics Ecosystem by 2030
item.description: South Korea is allocating $1.66 billion directly to humanoid robotics and $2.0 billion for physical AI field verification, targeting an 80% domestic component localization rate and state procurement of over 1,000 bipedal units.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AGIBOT Tops Medal Table at 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games as Beijing Showdown Concludes
item.description: AGIBOT secures first place with 46 medals at the 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games, narrowly edging out TianGong in a fierce multi-discipline competition showcasing mass-produced hardware.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: SoftBank in Talks for Majority Stake in 1X at $6 Billion — Below the $10 Billion It Sought Last Year
item.description: Masayoshi Son''s investment powerhouse is reportedly negotiating a controlling interest in OpenAI-backed humanoid maker 1X Technologies, at a figure well under the valuation the company pursued last September.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Hyundai Says Atlas Will Not Replace Workers — One Day After Settling a Strike Over Exactly That
item.description: At its 2026 CEO Investor Day, Hyundai put hard numbers behind Atlas for the first time: 30,000 units of annual US capacity from 2028, 25,000 already spoken for. It also went out of its way to insist robots are "in service of humans" — a line delivered 24 hours after its Korean union settled a walkout that demanded protection from automation.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Asimov 1 DIY Humanoid Kits Begin Shipping as Team Details Final Costs
item.description: Menlo Research and the Asimov team are shipping the first batch of their open-source Asimov 1 DIY humanoid kit, locking in a final delivered price of $20,000.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Figure AI Unveils Index: Crowdsourcing Real-World Human Video to Train Helix
item.description: Figure AI has exited stealth on Index, a crowdsourced data-collection platform that has gathered over 16 million video uploads across 108 countries to train its Helix neural network.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Skild AI Unveils S1: In-Context Learning for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
item.description: Skild AI has detailed S1, a foundation model that executes unseen, 10-minute manipulation tasks from a single video prompt without task-specific post-training.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Pink Robotics Emerges in Germany With a Mission to Revive Industrial Engineering
item.description: Darmstadt-based startup Pink Robotics has unveiled its P0 humanoid prototype, aiming to tackle logistics sorting while mounting a sharp critique of Germany’s current robotics ecosystem.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: AdaPT Bridges Sim-to-Real to Teach Humanoids the Tennis Styles of Federer, Nadal, and Djokovic
item.description: Researchers from Shanghai AI Lab, Dobot, SJTU, and Noitom introduce AdaPT, an adaptive planning and tracking framework that extracts stylized tennis rallying and serving from broadcast footage.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Figure AI Demonstrates 15-Foot Autonomous Ladder Ascent and Descent for Industrial Mezzanines
item.description: Figure CEO Brett Adcock shared video of a Figure 03 humanoid autonomously climbing up and down a 15-foot ladder, confirming the vertical locomotion milestone maps directly to an active customer use case.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Robots Outrun Usain Bolt: Inside the Record-Shattering Spree at the 2nd World Humanoid Robot Games
item.description: Bipedal machines crossed a major athletic threshold in Beijing, smashing human sprinting and jumping benchmarks while facing persistent braking and autonomy challenges.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: XPENG Robotics Raises Over $900 Million at $6.3 Billion Valuation to Industrialize IRON Humanoid
item.description: XPENG has closed a record-breaking $900 million financing round for its humanoid robotics division, backed by IDG Capital, Alibaba, and Tencent, ahead of late-2026 mass production.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Generalist AI Unveils GEN-1.5: One-Shot Robot Learning and the End of Heavy Fine-Tuning
item.description: Generalist AI claims a GPT-3 moment for robotics, demonstrating a foundation model that learns new physical tasks in seconds from a single prompt.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Not Ready to Scale: Unitree CEO Wang Xingxing on Why Humanoids Still Aren’t Working in Factories
item.description: Days after Unitree’s blockbuster listing, founder Wang Xingxing used his WRC 2026 stage time to explain why the company has held back from large-scale factory deployment — and laid out the generalization bottleneck, the "lossy" nature of physical AI, and a self-evolving software loop aimed at both.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Global Humanoid Shipments Surpass 22,000 in H1 2026 as AGIBOT Leads and Form-Factor Debates Intensify
item.description: A new report from Counterpoint Research reveals global humanoid shipments surged nearly 300% in the first half of 2026, with AGIBOT capturing top market share while the industry grapples with how to define humanoid form factors.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: From Marathons to the Factory Floor: Beijing’s World Humanoid Robot Games Pivot to Real-World Utility
item.description: With over 2,000 robots descending on Beijing, the second World Humanoid Robot Games signal a critical industry shift from viral agility demonstrations to commercial viability and complex physical labor.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Unitree Soars Over 600% in Shanghai IPO, Cements China’s Lead in Humanoid Hardware
item.description: Unitree Robotics made its highly anticipated debut on the STAR Market, with shares surging as the company leverages massive scale, a DeepSeek AI partnership, and intense vertical integration to dominate the global robotics race.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Galbot Teases ET1 Bipedal Humanoid Ahead of WRC 2026 Debut
item.description: Beijing-based Galbot has released a cinematic teaser of its first bipedal humanoid, the ET1, showcasing athletic tennis capabilities ahead of its official unveiling at the World Robot Conference.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Brawlers or Builders? EngineAI’s T800 Navigates the Split Between Factory Work and Combat Sports
item.description: A highly polished new video shows EngineAI’s T800 humanoids working in a Luxshare-ICT factory, drawing a sharp contrast to the robot’s violent US debut in a San Francisco combat league over the weekend.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: No Robots Allowed: All Three Major US Airlines Ban Humanoids Over Battery Fire Risks
item.description: American Airlines has joined United, Delta, and Southwest in explicitly banning humanoid and animal-like robots from commercial flights, citing the severe fire hazards posed by massive lithium-ion batteries.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: From Importer to Integrator: RoboStore Rebrands as Robo Inc. Amid Sweeping US Hardware Bans
item.description: Confronting strict FCC import restrictions on foreign robots, top Unitree distributor RoboStore is launching Robo Inc. to focus on domestic assembly, cybersecurity vetting, and practical systems integration.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Schaeffler Cracks the Cost Bottleneck: Formed Strain Wave Gearboxes Target 2027 Mass Production
item.description: By replacing traditional machining with high-speed forming technology, the German industrial giant claims to cut manufacturing costs for critical humanoid joints by more than 25 percent.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Samsung Accelerates In-House Humanoid Development with Dedicated RX Unit and World Model AI
item.description: South Korean tech giant Samsung is reportedly developing an advanced proprietary humanoid robot separate from Rainbow Robotics, backing the project with a new direct-to-CEO division, custom actuators, and factory-level world models.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Unitree Unveils "Superman" Robot, Claims to Shatter Human Speed and Jump Records
item.description: With a reported top speed of 12.66 m/s and a 2-meter standing high jump, Unitree’s latest prototype appears to fulfill its CEO’s promise to outpace the world’s elite human athletes.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: Figure CEO Brett Adcock Claims Humanoids Are Already Delivering ROI Amid Severe Labor Shortages
item.description: In a recent podcast appearance, Figure founder Brett Adcock pushed back against humanoid hype, arguing that the true bottleneck is onboard intelligence, not hardware manufacturing, and claiming early customers are already seeing a real-world return on investment.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: LG to Unveil Next-Gen Humanoid Built on NVIDIA Isaac GR00T in Early 2027
item.description: LG has formalized a strategic partnership with NVIDIA to co-develop a bipedal humanoid robot, deploy wheel-based systems in U.S. factories, and build next-generation AI infrastructure.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)

item.title: San Mateo County Moves to Regulate Humanoid Robots, Threatening Teleoperation Business Models
item.description: A new resolution in San Mateo County aims to mandate on-site human supervision, automation impact fees, and strict fire safety requirements for commercial humanoids, setting a high regulatory bar for physical AI startups.
item.author: contact@humanoidsdaily.com (Humanoids Daily Staff)
